Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
None turned up on behalf of the complainant despite notice.

2. The F.I.R. in question was lodged alleging the commission of offence of rape on the daughter of the informant, subsequently in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she was pregnant and was carrying a fetus of 8-9 months and did not support the prosecution story.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that on account of physical relations, a child was born on 26.12.2022 and she wanted to marry the applicant.
She also stated that nothing wrong was done to her.
Tentatively the age of the victim is around 18 years.

3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
4. Considering the said two statements wherein the victim did not support the prosecution story and the tentative age of the victim is more than 17 years coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 13.02.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Manoj @ Mahajan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 17 of 2023, under Sections 376 IPC and Section 5(J)(2)/5 (N)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Leelapur, District Pratapgarh, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.1.2024 Arun  Manoj @ Mahajan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24402152/
